title: The Dark Side of Ayurveda Courses
description:
Ayurveda is often glorified as India’s “holy” system of healing, but behind the curtain lies a dark reality — misogyny baked into the curriculum itself.

This video exposes how the official BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine & Surgery) syllabus still teaches students to see women as objects. A recent fourth-year exam paper asked students to write about “Stree as a Vajikarana Dravya” — literally translating to “woman as an aphrodisiac.”

The shocking part? This isn’t a rogue question. It comes directly from government-approved textbooks, written under the Central Council of Indian Medicine, which still describe women as mere tools for male pleasure and reproduction.

Instead of teaching respect, equality, and modern medical science, these courses teach students to objectify women, mixing pseudoscience with patriarchy. Ayurveda here shows its true colors — not only pseudoscientific and casteist, but deeply regressive.

In the 21st century, should we really be training doctors with such outdated, misogynistic garbage?

If you’ve searched for Ayurveda exposed, misogyny in Ayurveda, Ayurvedic course syllabus, women objectified Ayurveda, or truth about Ayurvedic medicine, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Like, comment, share, and hype this video so more people see the reality of what is being taught in the name of “heritage.”
